description: This source file defines the 'User' class for the OpenMRS system, representing a user account with properties such as username, email, roles, and associated person information. It includes methods for role and privilege management, property handling, and user identification within the system.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user account within the OpenMRS system, encapsulating user credentials, roles, properties, and audit information. Implements interfaces for attribute handling and auditing, and supports role-based privilege management.

methods.name: isSuperUser
methods.description: Checks if the user has the superuser role, granting all privileges.

methods.name: hasPrivilege
methods.description: Determines if the user has a specific privilege based on their roles.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Checks if the user possesses a specific role, with options to ignore superuser status.

methods.name: containsRole
methods.description: Case-insensitive check for the presence of a role among the user's roles.

methods.name: getPrivileges
methods.description: Retrieves all privileges granted to the user through their roles.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Returns all roles of the user, including inherited parent roles.

methods.name: addRole
methods.description: Adds a role to the user.

methods.name: removeRole
methods.description: Removes a role from the user.

methods.name: getProficientLocales
methods.description: Returns a list of locales the user is proficient in, parsed from user properties.
